name: Run report or setup problem
about: Tell us what happened on your machine, including a clean pass or where you stopped.
title: ""
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

What did you try? A bundled demo, your own agent, your own task, or a command that stopped you? Give the task name or command and the first result that mattered.

What happened? If an agent took part, include whether it claimed completion and what the verifier found. For a graded run, the useful fields are `verify_pass`, `verified_pass`, `false_completion` and `scope_violation`. A short error excerpt is enough for a setup problem.

What did you expect, and would you use this check again? If relevant, include your operating system, Python version, and checkout (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`). Please leave out credentials, private paths and raw agent transcripts.
